created_before: Any wave12 fit or development score
preserved_parent_policy: The failed wave11 mandatory ensemble and all earlier gates remain unchanged
population: All twelve original metadata-selected datasets and all three libraries
new_hypothesis: A mandatory new single-model policy: four frozen profile refits on each of eight binary/regression tasks and each library; carry all four multiclass wave10 single-model policies unchanged. This is a predeclared policy change after failed ensemble development, not a per-task selection between ensembles and singles.

grid.ctboost: Original wave8 selected tree controls except alpha in [0.5,0.8] times learning rate [original,original/2]. Alpha remains strictly below1; feature testing precedes cut selection.
grid.xgboost: Original selected controls except min_child_weight in [original(default1),max(0.25,original/4)] times eta [original,original/2].
grid.lightgbm: Original selected controls except min_data_in_leaf in [original(default20),max(1,floor(original/4))] times learning rate [original,original/2].
grid.budgets: 96 fresh tree fits in total. Base-rate profiles use cap2000/patience50; half-rate profiles use cap4000/patience100. Apply this scaling to all libraries, record cap hits and actual fit costs. This approximately preserves learning-rate-times-rounds horizon, not equal compute. Original-control repeats remain explicit reproducibility/control fits, not unique hypotheses.

stopping_and_selection: Use only original TRAIN and independent STOP. Native primary-metric early stopping first selects each uncorrected tree prefix. Recompute already-selected fixed regression/binary correction controls on TRAIN using exact original ordered CT preprocessing, then select the profile by its actual corrected native STOP error. This is not corrected-prefix optimization. The incumbent is the original wave8 TRAIN model with the frozen post-fit policy: saved regression correction already folded, selected binary correction recomputed without new selection. Exact STOP ties preserve this incumbent; new-profile ties prefer fewer retained rounds, then index.
mandatory_refit: Freeze all24 TRAIN-profile choices before refitting every chosen binary/regression model on TRAIN+STOP at its selected retained rounds, with fresh union vocabulary and unchanged correction controls. No early stopping, union STOP selection or original-versus-union fallback. Carry12 multiclass wave10 single models and freeze all36 final native models before development.
seed947_trigger: Only a successful36-model wave12 development gate opens the independent fixed947 robustness run. Existing947 models from failed wave11 are never substituted for these new required refits.
seed947_policy: Refit all36 policies on the same union, changing only learner seed. Reuse exact selected requested rounds, tree parameters, correction penalties/shrinkages/solvers and multiclass temperatures. No HPO, early stopping or post-fit reselection.
aggregation: Average primary error across47 and947 within each of12 datasets, then compare dataset means. Report both seeds separately. Same-split seeds are not independent datasets or a significance test.
if_gate_fails: Preserve this failed mandatory policy and keep official outer test and original14 confirmation sealed. Further work needs a new predeclared hypothesis.

official_test_after_gate.authorization: User authorized one-shot assessment after final policy/model freeze
official_test_after_gate.split: Original OpenML repeat0/fold0/sample0 outer-test rows, uncapped
official_test_after_gate.preconditions: Freeze72 native model hashes plus exact source/runtime/policy/cache/split identities before reading official test features or labels
official_test_after_gate.models: Score already trained47 and947 policies with no further fit or adjustment
official_test_after_gate.aggregation: Same two-seed mean primary error within each of twelve datasets
official_test_after_gate.limitations: Adaptive reused development, partial capped outer training, twelve tasks and two learner seeds; not an official TabArena ranking, universal superiority or significance claim. Original14 confirmation fold7 remains sealed.
